data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Marthéas, which is a contraction of Mary. In the New Testament, Mary Magdalene is called Marthas, which may have influenced this name. The name Martie carries the meaning “Mary like” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Martie usually hope their child will grow to embody mary like and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Martie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mary like.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Martie total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
data.cultural_impact: The name Martie, as a variant of Mary, carries a rich cultural legacy. In Christianity, Mary was the mother of Jesus Christ, and in Western religious iconography, she is often depicted as the embodiment of maternal love, kindness, and faith. The cultural influence of the name Martie can be seen in the reverence accorded to the name and the virtues it represents.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Martie, derived from Mary, holds deep spiritual significance. The name represents a strong connection to Jesus Christ and his mother Mary. It is believed that carrying the name Martie confers blessings and protection from the divine, inspiring the bearer to live a virtuous and pious life. Mary, as the mother of Christ, was a model of faith, obedience, and love, and the name Martie serves as a constant reminder of these virtues.
